title: 1 John Chapter 5 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 John chapter 5 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 John Chapter 5 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 John Chapter 5.

questions.question: In 1 John 5, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ
For this is the love of God
By this we know that we love the children of God
Who is he that overcometh the world
questions.correctAnswer: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ
questions.explanation: This is the first statement made in the chapter, found in 1 John 5:1.

questions.question: What do we know when we love God, according to 1 John 5?
options: We love the children of God
questions.correctAnswer: We love the children of God
questions.explanation: This is stated in 1 John 5:2, indicating that love for God is linked to love for His children.

questions.question: What is the love of God according to 1 John 5:3?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:3 explicitly states that the love of God is keeping His commandments.

questions.question: What overcomes the world according to 1 John 5:4?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:4 states that the victory that overcomes the world is our faith.

questions.question: Who is identified as the one who overcometh the world in 1 John 5:5?
options: He that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God
The one who keeps His commandments
questions.correctAnswer: He that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God
questions.explanation: This is directly stated in 1 John 5:5.

questions.question: What came by water and blood according to 1 John 5:6?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6 specifically states that Jesus Christ came by water and blood.

questions.question: What does the Spirit bear witness to, according to 1 John 5:6?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6 mentions that the Spirit bears witness because the Spirit is truth.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:7, how many bear record in heaven?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7 states that there are three that bear record in heaven.

questions.question: Which three bear record in heaven according to 1 John 5:7?
options: The Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit
The Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost
The Father, the Spirit, and the Word
Jesus, the Father, and the Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: The Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7 specifies that the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost bear record in heaven.

questions.question: Are the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost one according to 1 John 5:7?
options: Only the Father and the Word
Only the Word and the Holy Ghost
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7 states that these three are one.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:3, are God's commandments grievous?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:3 states that His commandments are not grievous.

questions.question: Does 1 John 5:4 mention that whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:4 explicitly states that whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world.

questions.question: Is loving God associated with keeping His commandments in 1 John 5:2?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:2 indicates that we know we love the children of God when we love God and keep His commandments.

questions.question: Is it stated in 1 John 5 that Jesus is the Son of Mary?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5 does not mention Jesus being the Son of Mary; it refers to Jesus as the Son of God.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5, does the Spirit bear witness of the world?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6 states that the Spirit bears witness because the Spirit is truth, not about the world.

medium.title: 1 John Chapter 5 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 John Chapter 5 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What are the three that bear witness on earth according to 1 John 5:8?
options: The spirit, the water, and the blood
The Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost
The commandments, the prophets, and the Psalms
questions.correctAnswer: The spirit, the water, and the blood
questions.explanation: This is found in 1 John 5:8, which states that the spirit, the water, and the blood bear witness on earth.

questions.question: What does 1 John 5:10 say will happen to those who do not believe God?
options: They have made Him a liar
questions.correctAnswer: They have made Him a liar
questions.explanation: According to 1 John 5:10, those who believe not God have made Him a liar because they do not believe the record He gave of His Son.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:11, what has God given to us?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:11 clearly states that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

questions.question: What does 1 John 5:12 say about having the Son?
options: He that hath the Son hath life
He that hath the Son shall never die
He that hath the Son shall be poor
He that hath the Son shall be happy
questions.correctAnswer: He that hath the Son hath life
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:12 states that he who has the Son has life, indicating the importance of belief in Christ for eternal life.

questions.question: What assurance does 1 John 5:13 provide to believers?
options: That they will have many friends
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:13 assures believers that they may know they have eternal life by believing on the name of the Son of God.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:14, what does the confidence in Him allow us to do?
options: Ask anything according to His will
Have all our prayers answered immediately
questions.correctAnswer: Ask anything according to His will
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:14 indicates that we have confidence to ask anything according to His will, and He hears us.

questions.question: What do 1 John 5:1 and 1 John 5:2 suggest about love for God's children?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:2 states that we know we love the children of God when we love God and keep His commandments, linking love for God and love for His children.

questions.question: What is the victory that overcomes the world according to 1 John 5:4?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:4 states that whatsoever is born of God overcomes the world, and this victory is through our faith.

questions.question: In 1 John 5:6, what is emphasized as being truth?
questions.explanation: According to 1 John 5:6, the Spirit bears witness and is truth, emphasizing the role of the Spirit in revealing God's truth.

questions.question: What does the record mentioned in 1 John 5:11 refer to?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:11 states that the record is that God has given us eternal life, which is found in His Son.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:7, who bears record in heaven?
options: The Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost
questions.correctAnswer: The Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7 states that there are three that bear record in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:3, how do we demonstrate our love for God?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:3 explains that keeping His commandments is how we show our love for God.

questions.question: Is it true that believing in the Son of God provides assurance of eternal life?
questions.explanation: This statement is true, as 1 John 5:13 assures that those who believe on the name of the Son of God may know they have eternal life.

questions.question: Is it true that having the Son guarantees that a person will never face challenges?
questions.explanation: This statement is false because having the Son does not mean we will be free from challenges; it means we have eternal life.

questions.question: Is it true that the Spirit is the truth that bears witness according to 1 John 5:6?
questions.explanation: This statement is false because 1 John 5:6 states that it is indeed the Spirit that bears witness and is truth.

hard.title: 1 John Chapter 5 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 John Chapter 5.

questions.question: What can we be confident about if we know that He hears us?
options: We know that we have the petitions that we desired of Him.
We will receive gifts from Him.
We can pray for anything we want.
questions.correctAnswer: We know that we have the petitions that we desired of Him.
questions.explanation: This is confirmed in 1 John 5:15, stating that if we know He hears us, we know we have what we asked for.

questions.question: What should one do if they see a brother sin a sin not unto death?
questions.explanation: According to 1 John 5:16, if someone sees a brother sinning a sin not unto death, they shall ask, and he shall give him life.

questions.question: According to 1 John 5:18, what is true of whosoever is born of God?
options: They are free from all worldly concerns.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:18 states that whosoever is born of God does not sin, indicating a transformative relationship with God.

questions.question: What does 1 John 5:20 affirm about the Son of God?
options: He has not given us understanding.
He has come and given us understanding.
He is not connected to the true God.
questions.correctAnswer: He has come and given us understanding.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:20 confirms that the Son of God has come and provided us with understanding to know Him that is true.

questions.question: What does 1 John 5:21 warn against?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:21 instructs little children to keep themselves from idols, indicating a warning against idolatry.

questions.question: How does John describe all unrighteousness in 1 John 5:17?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:17 states that all unrighteousness is sin, providing a clear definition of what constitutes sin.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'petitions' in 1 John 5:15 mean?
questions.explanation: 'Petitions' in the original Greek refers to requests made in prayer, affirming the nature of communication with God.

questions.question: What literary device is used in 1 John 5:16 regarding sin?
questions.explanation: The verse employs parallelism by contrasting sin unto death and sin not unto death in its structure.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of eternal life as mentioned in 1 John 5:20?
questions.explanation: John 3:16 connects with the theme of eternal life, affirming God's gift of eternal life through belief in His Son.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the idea of overcoming the world mentioned in 1 John 5:4?
questions.explanation: Romans 8:37 states that we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us, echoing the theme of overcoming found in 1 John 5:4.

questions.question: What comes immediately before 1 John 5:19?
options: He that hath the Son hath life.
The whole world lieth in wickedness.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:18 precedes 1 John 5:19, stating that we know we are of God, which leads into the declaration about the world.

questions.question: What is the main theme of 1 John 5:12?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:12 emphasizes that having the Son is essential for life, making the relationship with Him pivotal.

questions.question: In 1 John 5:14, what is the condition for God hearing our requests?
options: If we ask according to His will.
questions.correctAnswer: If we ask according to His will.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:14 clearly states that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us, showing the importance of alignment with His purpose.

questions.question: True or False: All unrighteousness is considered sin according to 1 John 5:17.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:17 explicitly states that all unrighteousness is sin, affirming the truth of this statement.

questions.question: True or False: 1 John 5:21 encourages believers to keep themselves from idols.
questions.explanation: This statement is true; 1 John 5:21 indeed encourages believers to keep themselves from idols, affirming the warning against idolatry.

theological.title: 1 John Chapter 5 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 John Chapter 5 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does 1 John 5:4 teach about the believer's relationship to the world?
options: Those born of God overcome the world by faith
Believers are exempt from worldly suffering
The world is inherently good and to be embraced
Victory over the world comes by human effort alone
questions.correctAnswer: Those born of God overcome the world by faith
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:4 states that 'whosoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith,' teaching that the believer overcomes the world through faith.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning eternal life does 1 John 5:11 teach?
options: Eternal life is given by God and is found in His Son
Eternal life is a reward for human righteousness
Eternal life is only a future hope with no present reality
Eternal life is granted through adherence to the law
questions.correctAnswer: Eternal life is given by God and is found in His Son
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:11 teaches that 'God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son,' emphasizing that eternal life is a gift from God through Jesus Christ.

questions.question: What doctrine about sin and sanctification is taught in 1 John 5:18?
options: Those born of God do not continue in sin and are protected from the evil one
True believers are incapable of sinning at all
Sanctification is achieved by human discipline without divine aid
All sin is equal and leads to spiritual death
questions.correctAnswer: Those born of God do not continue in sin and are protected from the evil one
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:18 states that 'whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not,' indicating that believers do not habitually sin and are guarded from Satan.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does 1 John 5:14 specifically demonstrate?
options: God's faithfulness in hearing prayers according to His will
questions.correctAnswer: God's faithfulness in hearing prayers according to His will
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:14 says, 'if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us,' demonstrating God's faithfulness and responsiveness to prayer in alignment with His will.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is underscored in 1 John 5:7 regarding the unity of the Godhead?
options: Divine unity of Father, Word, and Holy Ghost
questions.correctAnswer: Divine unity of Father, Word, and Holy Ghost
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7 speaks of 'three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one,' highlighting the unity of the Trinity as a divine attribute.

questions.question: How does 1 John 5:6 connect to the broader New Testament witness about Jesus Christ?
options: It affirms the incarnation through water and blood, aligning with the Synoptic Gospels' baptism and crucifixion accounts
It contradicts the Gospel accounts by denying Jesus' humanity
It emphasizes Jesus' role solely as a prophet without divine status
It denies the Spirit’s role in testifying about Christ
questions.correctAnswer: It affirms the incarnation through water and blood, aligning with the Synoptic Gospels' baptism and crucifixion accounts
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6 states Jesus 'came by water and blood,' which corresponds to the baptism (water) and crucifixion (blood) recorded in the Gospels, affirming both His humanity and divine mission.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical theme does 1 John 5:20 fulfill regarding knowledge of God?
options: The revelation of the true God through Jesus Christ grants believers understanding
Knowledge of God is purely intellectual without relational impact
Old Testament knowledge suffices without Christ's revelation
Faith is blind and does not involve true knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: The revelation of the true God through Jesus Christ grants believers understanding
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:20 teaches that the Son of God has given us understanding to know the true God, fulfilling the theme of divine revelation culminating in Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do 1 John 5:9 and 1 John 5:10 teach about the witness to Jesus Christ?
options: The witness of God about His Son is greater than human testimony, and belief in the Son confirms the witness within oneself
Human witnesses are more reliable than God's testimony
Belief in Jesus is optional for receiving God's witness
The Spirit does not bear witness about Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: The witness of God about His Son is greater than human testimony, and belief in the Son confirms the witness within oneself
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:9-10 emphasize that God's testimony about Jesus surpasses human testimony and that true believers have the witness in themselves, confirming the Son's divine identity.

questions.question: What doctrine about prayer and assurance is taught by combining 1 John 5:14 and 1 John 5:15?
options: Confidence in prayer comes from knowing God hears requests made according to His will, assuring believers receive what they ask
Prayer is ineffective regardless of God's will
God answers all prayers without regard to His will
Assurance in prayer is based on human merit
questions.correctAnswer: Confidence in prayer comes from knowing God hears requests made according to His will, assuring believers receive what they ask
questions.explanation: Verses 14 and 15 teach that if we ask anything according to God's will, He hears us, and we can be confident that we receive what we ask for, stressing assurance in prayer.

questions.question: What doctrine about sin and intercession is taught by 1 John 5:16-17 when taken together?
options: There is a sin not unto death for which believers can pray and obtain life for the sinner
All sins are unto death and beyond prayer
Prayer cannot affect the spiritual state of others
questions.correctAnswer: There is a sin not unto death for which believers can pray and obtain life for the sinner
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:16-17 explain that some sins are not unto death and that prayer can bring life for such sinners, distinguishing between sin unto death and other sins.

questions.question: Skeptics claim 1 John 5:7-8 contains a later addition and thus lacks biblical authority. What does 1 John 5:6-8 actually teach about the testimony concerning Jesus Christ?
options: The testimony about Jesus includes water, blood, and the Spirit, providing a comprehensive witness to His identity
Only the Spirit bears witness and the water and blood are symbolic later additions
The passage denies the Trinity and the Spirit's testimony
The witness in heaven is irrelevant to earthly faith
questions.correctAnswer: The testimony about Jesus includes water, blood, and the Spirit, providing a comprehensive witness to His identity
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6-8 shows that Jesus came by water and blood, and the Spirit bears witness, forming a tripartite earthly testimony confirming Jesus' identity, regardless of textual debates about verse 7.

questions.question: What doctrine about love and obedience is taught in 1 John 5:2-3?
options: Love for God is demonstrated by keeping His commandments, which are not burdensome
Obedience is unrelated to love for God
God's commandments are impossible to keep
Love is purely emotional without ethical implications
questions.correctAnswer: Love for God is demonstrated by keeping His commandments, which are not burdensome
questions.explanation: Verses 2 and 3 teach that love for God is shown by loving His children and keeping His commandments, which are not grievous, connecting love and obedience.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is emphasized in 1 John 5:19 regarding God's sovereignty over the believer in contrast to the world?
options: God's providential protection of His children
God's wrathful destruction of the world
questions.correctAnswer: God's providential protection of His children
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:19 contrasts the believer's origin from God with the world's lying in wickedness, implying God's sovereign protection and care over His children.

questions.question: What combined doctrine about assurance of salvation is taught by 1 John 5:12 and 1 John 5:13?
options: Possession of the Son guarantees life, and the author writes so believers may know they have eternal life
Salvation is uncertain even for those who have the Son
Eternal life depends on works, not on possessing the Son
Assurance is based solely on church membership
questions.correctAnswer: Possession of the Son guarantees life, and the author writes so believers may know they have eternal life
questions.explanation: Verses 12 and 13 teach that having the Son equates to having life and that the letter is written so believers may know they have eternal life, affirming assurance based on Christ.

questions.question: What narrative connection does 1 John 5:21 make regarding idolatry and Christian life?
options: Believers are warned to keep themselves from idols, continuing Old Testament ethical imperatives into the Christian context
Idolatry is acceptable if it is cultural
Idols are only physical objects with no spiritual consequences
The New Testament abolishes concerns about idolatry
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are warned to keep themselves from idols, continuing Old Testament ethical imperatives into the Christian context
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:21 commands believers to 'keep yourselves from idols,' connecting Christian ethical faithfulness to the Old Testament prohibition of idolatry.
